numeric_rules.definition: Using initial complex 1 in Fig.S1 as zero, the target relative G of TS1 is 18.9 kcal/mol with an absolute tolerance of 1.0 kcal/mol; include all spectator material and maintain 383.15 K. Do not directly compare results using separated-reactant zeroes, isomeric phosphines or different chemical compositions.

Using Fig.S1 complex 1 and matched spectator material as the initial reference, the balanced endpoint of product 9, PEt3 and ethanol has a target relative G of −24.7 kcal/mol with an absolute tolerance of 2.0 kcal/mol. Maintain 383.15 K and compatible solvent and standard state; do not use separated-reactant values or authors' energies to fill gaps in local calculations.

notes: The existing product free-energy residual is approximately −7.087. The rules primarily assess scientific propositions; no additional exact numerical thresholds were introduced. Stoichiometric balance, geometries and thermal corrections must be reviewed before quantitative comparison.
